summary: Implementation plan to simplify DAISY by removing Google Sheets OAuth, admin login/export buttons, and the Telemetry Debug toggle, while hiding the Mesoscale Discussion UI cards and integrating a 4-step background SPC Mesoscale Discussion + HRRR/Sounding Composite Tornado Scoring Engine (STP, 0-1km SRH, LCL, CAPE/CIN, and temporal/spatial MD indexing).
